scope: CPU AVX2 length2/4/8 NTT butterflies in both DIT and forward DIF. Larger stages use the existing SIMD loops. Degrees2/4 and builds without AVX2 retain scalar stages.
layout: Length2 packs4 independent butterflies; Montgomery-one twiddle multiplication omitted exactly.
Length4 packs2 butterflies blocks, repeating each half and its twiddles within128-bit lanes.
Length8 packs one block, repeating low/high128-bit halves and four twiddles.
DIT multiplies the odd half before sum/difference; DIF multiplies the difference after the butterfly. Canonical outputs stay below p in either residue domain.
controls: NegacyclicNTTPlan(size,prime,false) disables only these new short-stage kernels. Existing large-stage vectorization remains enabled.

oracles: Independent64-bit natural-order NTT with explicit bit-reversal comparison
Full-size exact FFT tensors and schoolbook tensors at N16
Factor digit-CRT reference and existing policy/geometry guards
cases: head/tail factor SIMD tails and chunk remainders
correctness.factor_result: direct RNS and digit-CRT cached head/tail factors byte-identical; no online reads or selector transforms; retained bytes=41674640

benchmark.method: Scalar-short/SIMD-short/SIMD-short/scalar-short,5 calls per phase. Each sample32 forward/inverse round trips; omit phase-first calls. Single pinned P core0; all result arrays unchanged. Compilation completed before timing.
benchmark.limitation: Isolated transform improvements do not establish full FBS gains.
